title: The 1787 text gives Congress the power to declare war
summary: The 1787 text gives Congress the power to declare war.
body: Among the powers Article I, Section 8 lists in the 1787 transcription is the power to declare war, to raise and support armies, and to provide and maintain a navy. The source says: "the Law of Nations; To declare War, grant Letters of Marque and Reprisal, and make Rules concerning Captures on Land and Water; To raise and support Armies, but no Appropriation of Money to that Use shall be for a longer Term than two Years; To provide and maintain a Navy; To make Rules for the Government and Regulation of the land and naval Forces; To provide for calling" Listing the power in Congress is the text. How that list sits beside the commander-in-chief clause is a further question this card does not answer.
